env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Const map lookups lower without loops or map fallbacks.
cd m
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
# Switch lookup: 8 key cases plus the absent path.
grep -count=8 'case [0-9]:' out/main.go
grep 'return zero, false' out/main.go
# Table lookup: exactly one table Get call.
grep -count=1 '_tab\.Get\(' out/main.go
! grep 'for ' out/main.go
# No loop and no logarithmic fallback in the lowered lookups.
! grep 'sort\.' out/main.go
! grep 'BinarySearch' out/main.go
! grep 'binarySearch' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmshape

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

const eight = map[int]string{1: "a", 2: "b", 3: "c", 4: "d", 5: "e", 6: "f", 7: "g", 8: "h"}

const nine = map[int]string{1: "a", 2: "b", 3: "c", 4: "d", 5: "e", 6: "f", 7: "g", 8: "h", 9: "i"}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(eight[3] ?? "none", eight[9] ?? "none")
	fmt.Println(nine[5] ?? "none", nine[10] ?? "none")
}
